title: The Monkey and the Fishermen
summary: A monkey saw fishermen cast nets and tried to imitate them. Tangling his arms and legs in the cords, he tumbled into the water and drowned....
full_text: A monkey saw fishermen cast nets and tried to imitate them. Tangling his arms and legs in the cords, he tumbled into the water and drowned.
moral: Attempting to practice an art without learning it entangles you in the net.
image_alt: The Monkey and the Fishermen illustration from the Aesop's Fables collection.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Monkey and the Fishermen"?
options: Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.

author: Aesop (~620–564 BCE / Trans. George Fyler Townsend)
